name: 20059-random1k100-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, dense decoder, 8.0B parameters: 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, vocab 128256, rope_theta 5e5, max_position_embeddings 8192, bf16.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=25 req/s, bounded at 1500 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 1000 tokens (min = max = 1000) and output EXACTLY 100 (min = max = 100); the fixed output length makes the backend force ignore_eos. temperature 0.0.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant giving short fixed-length answers to page-long prompts at 25 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for 20059-random1k100-8b-1gpu.
# The attention backend is not an engine argument at this commit -- it and its version are read
# from the environment, and are set in configs/tuned.yaml.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
